## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/security/advisories/new),
or email **security@example.com**.

Please include:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce (a proof of concept if possible)
- Affected version(s) and environment
- Any suggested fix

### What to expect

| Stage | Target |
| --- | --- |
| Acknowledgement of your report | 3 business days |
| Initial assessment | 10 business days |
| Fix or mitigation plan | 30 days |

We will credit you in the advisory unless you ask us not to.
